text:
marcus-partnerships: Quick sanity check — Nimbus sent their illustration pack for the marketplace tile but the illustrator license string is ambiguous. Can design/legal confirm before we publish?

jin-design: Got it. I looked through the SVGs — some are fine, a few have embedded raster textures. Also margin/pad is off for our 240x160 thumbnail frame. Screenshot: https://redwood-assets.s3/preview/nimbus-pack-01.png

olivia-marketing: We need the quote attribution too — Vincent asked to use "Nimbus Systems" copy. Does the partner have photo release for the customer headshot in the case study?

priya-legal: License note: the license header in the illustrator file says "CC BY-SA 4.0" but there's an extra line that looks like a third-party asset restriction ("no-commercial redistribution"). That's conflicting. If that's true we can't include it in a paid marketplace listing. Can we request a clean commercial grant from them?

leo-product: Technical ask: marketplace thumbnail can be either 240x160 PNG or a vector exported w/ correct viewbox. If they send a raster, we need 2x @2x for hi-dpi. Also we should avoid UI screenshots with customer PII — flagged one in the pack.

jin-design: Propose these deliverables back to Nimbus: 1) PNG 240x160 @1x and @2x, 2) SVG with flattened textures removed, 3) clear alt-text string (see below), 4) confirmed commercial rights for all included assets.

assets-bot: checklist created: #nimbus-marketplace -> https://redwood-assets.s3/checks/1932104567-checklist.json :thumbsup:

priya-legal: Alt-text suggestion for the hero illustration (editable):
```
Illustration of a cloud platform connecting enterprise systems, stylized Nimbus-branded accent in the top-right. No product screenshots or customer data shown.
```
Will ask them to sign the commercial license addendum.

olivia-marketing: Also request a short one-line customer quote confirmation like: "Nimbus helped us reduce latency by 30%" + named approver. We should avoid vague claims. If they want a metric included we need a source.

marcus-partnerships: I'll ping Vincent and ask for the two things: commercial license addendum + high-res thumbnail/SVG with flattened textures removed. I'll include Priya's alt-text and Olivia's quote guidance.

marcus-partnerships: Pinged Vincent: "Can you confirm commercial re-use for all assets and provide the export set (PNG 240x160, PNG 480x320, SVG) + quote approver?"

vincent-nimbus (external): Thanks Marcus — sending updated pack and license now, ETA EOD.

jin-design: Perfect. Once we get files I'll run a quick crop pass and drop updated thumbnails into staging.

assets-bot: staging upload: https://staging.redwood.ai/marketplace/nimbus/1932104567/ (pending files)

priya-legal: If license addendum arrives, drop it here and I'll sign off. Otherwise hold publishing.

leo-product: When staging is ready I'll validate tokenized screenshots and run the thumbnail resize job.

marcus-partnerships: Thanks team — holding publish until legal signoff and correct exports. Will update thread when I get the pack. :wave:
